pkgmetadata.longdescription: FEX is a usermode emulator that runs x86 and x86-64 Linux binaries on arm64 hosts. On a DGX Spark (GB10) it is what makes the Steam client and Proton usable: the guest's x86 code is translated, while the thunk libraries forward OpenGL and Vulkan calls straight to the native arm64 NVIDIA driver, so the GPU still runs at full speed.

use.flag: Enable FEX's offline telemetry, which records emulation statistics locally under ~/.fex-emu. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Build the host and guest thunk libraries, which forward guest x86 OpenGL, Vulkan, X11, Wayland and ALSA calls to the native arm64 host libraries. Required for usable GPU performance.
